# Test Audio Fixtures

- `ta-commonvoice-sample.wav`: Public-domain (CC0-1.0) spoken Tamil sample from Mozilla Common Voice (`"வணக்கம் ... நீங்க எப்படி இருக்கீங்க"`), used by `tests/test_onnx_specialist_asr.py` and `tests/test_tamil_offline_self_test.py` in CI environments where `private/` is absent. This directory is excluded from packaged desktop binaries and installers.
